# Atomic Deploy Script

## New File: `deploy/atomic_deploy.sh`

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Atomic Release Deploy Script
# Usage: ./atomic_deploy.sh <new_release_path>
# =============================================================================

# Configuration
readonly APP_ROOT="/srv/myapp"
readonly CURRENT_LINK="${APP_ROOT}/current"
readonly HEALTH_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"
readonly LOG_FILE="${APP_ROOT}/deploy.log"
readonly HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES=5
readonly HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL=2

# Logging function
log() {
    local timestamp
    timestamp="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo "[${timestamp}] $*" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
}

# Cleanup function for rollback
rollback() {
    local prev_release="$1"
    log "ROLLBACK: Restoring symlink to ${prev_release}"
    ln -sf "${prev_release}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"
    log "ROLLBACK: Symlink restored to ${prev_release}"
}

# Health check with retries
health_check() {
    local attempt=1
    while [[ ${attempt} -le ${HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES} ]]; do
        log "Health check attempt ${attempt}/${HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES}..."
        if curl -sf --max-time 5 "${HEALTH_URL}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            log "Health check PASSED"
            return 0
        fi
        log "Health check failed, retrying in ${HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL}s..."
        sleep "${HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL}"
        ((attempt++))
    done
    log "Health check FAILED after ${HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES} attempts"
    return 1
}

# Main deployment logic
main() {
    if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 <new_release_path>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local new_release="$1"

    log "=========================================="
    log "Starting atomic deploy: ${new_release}"
    log "=========================================="

    # Validate new release directory exists
    if [[ ! -d "${new_release}" ]]; then
        log "ERROR: New release directory does not exist: ${new_release}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Validate current symlink exists
    if [[ ! -L "${CURRENT_LINK}" ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Current symlink missing: ${CURRENT_LINK}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Get previous release path for rollback
    local prev_release
    prev_release="$(readlink -f "${CURRENT_LINK}")"
    log "Previous release: ${prev_release}"

    # Verify previous release still exists (safety check)
    if [[ ! -d "${prev_release}" ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Previous release directory missing: ${prev_release}"
        log "Cannot safely rollback. Aborting."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Perform atomic symlink swap
    log "Swapping symlink from ${prev_release} to ${new_release}"
    ln -sf "${new_release}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"
    log "Symlink updated to ${new_release}"

    # Health check
    if ! health_check; then
        log "ERROR: Health check failed"
        rollback "${prev_release}"
        log "ERROR: Deployment failed and rolled back"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "=========================================="
    log "Deployment SUCCESSFUL: ${new_release}"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"
```
